statement: 单独检索 Grammar Pattern 只能回答‘这种界面机制叫什么’；单独检索产品 Surface 只能回答‘哪里已经有这个具体界面’。Foundry 应将两者双向连接，再附上组合 Recipe、真实项目实现、Reference Demo/Visual Baseline 和缺失证据，使自然语言请求直接落到可复用语义与可核验具体实现。

scope.notes: Conservative Claim model of Experimental catalog record OPS.UIGS.CROSS_LAYER_EVIDENCE_RESOLVER; support threshold intentionally exceeds current independent evidence by one group.

review.rationale: Evidence-insufficient Experimental record modeled without promotion; additional independent evidence is required by policy.
